description: This file defines a custom logger class `testCustomCallbackProxy` that inherits from `CustomLogger`. It implements various logging methods for API calls, stream events, success, and failure events, including asynchronous variants. The class is intended for use in testing callbacks within the `litellm` framework, with additional initialization and method introspection code. It also creates an instance `my_custom_logger` of the class.

classes.name: testCustomCallbackProxy
classes.description: A subclass of `CustomLogger` designed for testing custom callback behaviors in the `litellm` framework. Implements methods for logging different stages of API calls and responses, including support for async callbacks.
